question: Apple's net income dipped from $96,995M in FY2023 to $93,736M in FY2024 before rising sharply to $112,010M in FY2025. What caused the FY2024 dip?
answer: Apple’s net income fell because the provision for income taxes more than doubled in FY2024, rising to $29,749 million [S5] from $16,741 million in FY2023 [S6], which more than offset higher operating income of $123,216 million [S3] versus $114,301 million [S4] and a $269 million gain in other income [1] versus a $565 million loss in FY2023 [1]. The result was net income of $93,736 million [S2] compared with $96,995 million [S1] the year before.
